text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith was stronger than ever,<n>but we come
out on top in the Unity<n>Cup finals. Our team is
overjoyed by<n>their accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite their loss, Little Cocon and<n>the others
proudly report to Ms.<n>Kashimoto that they were able
to beat<n>their target times that morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They tell her that they pushed<n>themselves beyond
their limits<n>because they love her and wanted to
destroy the beliefs she'd been<n>clinging on to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deeply touched by their sincerity, Ms.<n>Kashimoto
calls off Operation<n>Oversight. She also steps down
as<n>temporary director and decides to<n>start a new life
as a trainer at the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon and the others run to her,<n>happy at this
turn of events.
